vignette: A child undergoing conditioning for hematopoietic stem cell transplantation has red, ulcerated oral mucosa. The child reports pain and cannot eat.
stem: Which statement about this oral condition is most accurate?

options.text: When it is severe, it can force an interruption of the cancer treatment.
It is usually mild and painless and seldom limits the ability to eat.
Oral hygiene status has no bearing on how severe it becomes.
It arises only from chemotherapy and is not linked to head and neck radiation or transplant conditioning.
